content_sections.heading: IFCI Post-wise Experience Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates should have at least 15 years of experience in Public Sector Banks, the financial sector, consulting or dealing with government departments and ministries. Relevant experience should include credit appraisal, financial modelling, portfolio monitoring and recovery. Candidates should have at least 15 years of experience in estate management, property and building maintenance, operation and maintenance of commercial or residential buildings, civil works, electrical installations, vendor management, procurement and administrative functions. Candidates should have at least six years of post-qualification experience in the financial sector, consulting, credit appraisal, project or financial modelling, portfolio monitoring or recovery actions. Experience should include Advanced Chemistry Cells, energy storage, battery manufacturing, battery research, electric mobility or similar emerging technologies. Candidates should have at least six years of experience in banks, financial institutions, NBFCs or consulting firms in credit risk management, risk modelling, risk policy or Expected Credit Loss computation. Candidates should have experience in stressed asset resolution, corporate credit, project finance, appraisal, monitoring or recovery in a bank, financial institution, NBFC or consulting firm. Candidates should have experience in property management, building maintenance, civil works, mechanical or electrical systems, vendor management, GeM procurement, administration and security management. Candidates should have experience in recruitment, performance management, compensation, employee relations, disciplinary matters, labour laws or HR policy implementation. Candidates should have experience in electronics or electronic component manufacturing, capital equipment analysis, technical appraisal, plant and machinery verification or consultancy services for the electronics sector. Candidates should have experience in chemical, petrochemical, specialty chemical or process-industry projects, technical appraisal, project implementation, infrastructure monitoring or environmental compliance. Candidates should have experience in infrastructure development, industrial parks, large-scale projects, EPC, PMC, infrastructure consultancy, project appraisal, planning, implementation or monitoring.

content_sections.heading: IFCI Contract Period
content_sections.text: The engagement will initially be for three years. The contract may be extended further by mutual agreement between IFCI and the selected candidate. The selected candidate must execute an indemnity bond with a surety to serve IFCI for at least one year. A candidate resigning before completing one year will have to pay IFCI Rs.1 lakh, in addition to serving the prescribed notice period or paying salary in lieu of notice.

content_sections.heading: IFCI Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The IFCI selection process will include: Initial scrutiny of online Resume or Biodata Shortlisting based on qualification and experience Personal or online interview Document verification IFCI may restrict the number of candidates called for the interview by considering qualifications and experience higher than the minimum eligibility requirements. The interview may be conducted at New Delhi or through online mode, depending on the decision of IFCI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for IFCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should include the following information in their CV: Total experience Current CTC Expected CTC Notice period Current location Date of birth

content_sections.heading: Documents Required from Government Employees
content_sections.text: Candidates working in Central Government, State Government, semi-government organisations, autonomous bodies, CPSEs, PSUs or PSEs must provide the following documents if shortlisted for the interview: No Objection Certificate from the current employer Vigilance clearance certificate Certificate confirming that no disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated Integrity certificate
